newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu names new head of Zaire army.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu names new head of Zaire army.

text.p: President Mobutu Sese Seseko signed a decree on Wednesday appointing a new head of Zaire's army in his first official act since returning home from Europe to deal with a rebellion in the east, state television said.
Mobutu named respected general Mahele Bokoungo Lieko as army chief of staff, replacing civil guard commander General Baramoto Kpama, who was appointed to the post only last month.
The television said the move was "part of a restructuring of the Armed Forces of Zaire with the view to putting them on a war footing and improving their efficiency".
Mobutu would meet Zaire's political leaders on Thursday to discuss the crisis following the routing of the army by Rwandan-backed rebels, the television said.
Mobutu returned home on Tuesday after four months in Europe for cancer surgery and rest.
